'''Akial''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], having ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] shortly before a celebration that took place between around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] on [[Dorumaa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. Akial and Jedi Knight [[Krin D'bis]] were chosen by the [[Almas Academy]] to represent the [[Jedi academy|Academy]] at the celebration, presenting different approaches to being a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as a [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] respectively.

==Biography==
[[File:Living_Force_Campaign_Guide_cover_PotJ.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Akial represented the Almas Academy (pictured).]]
Akial was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Paarty On!" /> by between around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' dates the beginning of the campaign to around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], while "[[Below the Belt: Philology]]" shifts the campaign by ten years, therefore to around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. "[[Paarty On!]]" is set after the events of "Below the Belt: Philology" but before the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, it must be set between those [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] to become a [[Jedi Consular]],<ref name="Paarty On!" /> a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization that focused on studying the mysteries of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="SWRGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Shortly before a celebration that took place on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]]<ref name="Paarty On!" /> during this time,<ref name="Date" /> Akial passed his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Paarty On!" />

Also during that time,<ref name="Date" /> Akial and the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Krin D'bis]] were picked to visit the celebration organized by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] as the official representatives of the Jedi [[Almas Academy|academy]] on [[Almas]],<ref name="Paarty On!" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Dorumaa [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]].<ref name="Paarty On!" /> Akial and D'bis were chosen for the task by the [[Jedi academy|Academy]] due to their difference in opinion, to avoid presenting the Jedi as single-minded at the event. They traveled from Almas to the [[Greentree Pointe]] resort on Dorumaa, where the celebration was being held. The two Jedi set up a booth there in order to try and recruit potential students for the Academy.<ref name="Paarty On!" />

{{RPGseed}}
While at the celebration, Akial and D'bis happily debated with visitors of their booth on topics including the Cartel and the threat posed by the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Believers]].<ref name="Paarty On!" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Believer_Initiate.png|thumb|left|240px|Akial believed the Believers (pictured) should be investigated.]]
As a Consular and Guardian respectively, Akial and D'bis represented different paths that members of the Jedi Order could take, having different approaches to problems and representing the Jedi as diverse. Akial agreed with D'bis that the Believers were a significant problem, but while D'bis proposed a more aggresive solution, Akial thought it would be better to investigate the cult to be certain about their capabilities and who they were. He also disagreed with D'bis on the topic of the Metatheran Cartel, thinking that if the Cartel reestablished its [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] position within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and demonstrated itself to be trustworthy, they should be forgiven for their past transgressions. The Jawa disliked when others used<ref name="Paarty On!" /> the common [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] word<ref name="GPBaTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> "Utinni" while speaking to him, wrinkling his face whenever it happened.<ref name="Paarty On!" />

==Skills and abilities==
The Jawa [[Language/Legends|spoke]] flawless and unaccented [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Paarty On!" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akial appeared in the "[[Paarty On!]]" adventure of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign, released in [[2003]] and written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]]. "Paarty On!" erroneously uses the term "Jedi Counselor" to describe Akial's role of<ref name="Paarty On!" /> a Jedi Consular.<ref name="KOTOR 4">[[Knights of the Old Republic 4|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 4]]</ref>
